*Scheme Name*:
Dr Babasaheb Ambedkar Krushi Swavalamban Yojana (BAKSY)

*Main Component*:
Providing Irrigation Fscilities to the eligible beneficiaries of Scheduled Cast (SC) category

*Sub Component*:
1. New Irrigation Well
2. Old Well Repair
3. Plastic Lining of Farm Ponds
4. Inwell Boring
5. Electricity Connection
6. Pump Set (Diesel/Electric)
7. Solar pump (instead of electrical connection Charges and pump set)
8. HDPE/PVC Pipe (New Item)
9. Sprinkler Irrigation Set (Supplementary Grant) AND
     Drip Irrigation Set Supplementary Grant
10. Farm Machinery (bullock-drawn/tractor-drawn implements)
11. Backyard / Kitchen Garden

*Introduction*:
The Scheduled Caste Sub-Plan (Special Component Scheme(scp)) was being implemented from the year 1982-83 to increase the income of Scheduled Caste / New-Buddhist farmers and improve their standard of living. Since the said scheme has been implemented for a long period of time, the GOVERNMENT OF MAHARASHTRA has decided to implement the Special Component Scheme for Scheduled Caste / Neo-Buddhist farmers since 1982-83 and the recommendations of the Agriculture Commissionerate dated 27/04/2016 on the report dated 19/04/2016 and special component scheme the announced by the Hon'ble Minister (Finance). Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana is not being implemented separately, but the current special component scheme, Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana, is being implemented from 2016-17 as per the changed criteria, taking into account the needs of the changed situation and maintaining soil moisture.
Also, the government has approved the amendment in the financial criteria and inclusion of new components under the said scheme as per the government decision dated 01 October, 2024.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    beneficiary Selection criteria are as follows
1.  Scheme is only for Scheduled Caste/ Nav Baudha farmers.
2.  Scheme is implemented in all districts of Maharashtra (Except Mumbai districts).
3. At field level  scheme is under Implementation by department of Agriculture, Zilha Parishad.
4. Funds are released from Social Justice Department to concerned  District Collector and then made available to concern Zilha Parishad.
5. Application ,Selection of beneficiaries upto payment of subsidy all process are done through MAHADBT Portal through online system.                                                                  "

*Benefits*:
Benefit provided on subsidy basis as per the norms of components, through online system. The said scheme shall be implemented in the financial year 2025-26 as follows. In the said scheme, grants shall be admissible for the following components in the year 2025-26 up to the maximum limit of the amount mentioned below.
1. For New Irrigation- Well Maximum subsidy ammount limit is Rs.4,00,000/ - is admissible.
2. For Old Well Repair - Maximum subsidy ammount limit is 1,00,000/- is admissible
3. Plastic Lining of Farm Ponds-Grant shall be admissible up to 90% of the amount calculated as per the prevailing financial parameters of the National Horticulture Mission Guideline and the size of the farm pond or actual cost or Rs. 2,00,000/- whichever is less is admissible.
4.Inwell Boring- Maximum subsidy ammount limit is 40,000/- is admissible
5. Electricity Connection-Maximum subsidy ammount limit is Amount 20,000/- or actual paid amount whichever is less is admissible.
6. Pump Set (Diesel/Electric)(Diesel Engine - New Item) For pump sets up to 10 HP capacity, grant shall be admissible up to 90% of the prevailing financial parameters or actual cost or Rs. 40,000/- whichever is less is admissible.
7. Grant Solar pump (instead of electrical connection and pump set)- Maximum subsidy will be admissible up to 90% of the prevailing financial criteria or actual expenditure incurred or Rs. 50,000/- whichever is less is admissible.
8. HDPE/PVC Pipe (New Item)- Under the Food and Nutrition Security Scheme - Food Crops Scheme, subsidy of 100% of the prevailing economic standard or actual cost incurred per meter or Rs. 50,000/- whichever is less will be admissible.
9.1 For Micro irrigation system Under Sprinkler Irrigation Set (Supplementary Grant) 9.1.1) Under the Per Drop More Crop Scheme, (1) 55% for small/very small landholders + 25% from the Chief Minister's Sustainable Irrigation Scheme + 10% from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana and9.1.2) 45% for large landholders + 30% from the Chief Minister's Sustainable Irrigation Scheme + 15% from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana or Rs. 47,000/- whichever is less will be admissible as subsidy. (Total subsidy limit of 90 percent) is admissible
9.2 For Drip Irrigation Set Supplementary Grant 9.2.1 ) Under the Per Drop More Crop Scheme, (1) 55% for small/very small landholders + 25% from the Chief Minister's Sustainable Irrigation Scheme + 10% from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana and 9.2.2) 45% for large landholders + 30% from the Chief Minister's Sustainable Irrigation Scheme + 15% from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana or Rs. 97,000/- whichever is less will be admissible as subsidy.(Total subsidy limit of 90 percent) is admissible
10. Farm Machinery (bullock-drawn/tractor-drawn implements) (New item)maximum subsidy limit is 50,000/- is admissible
11. Backyard / Kitchen Garden (New Item) maximum subsidy limit is 50,000/- is admissible .

*Eligibility*:
1. Scheme is only for Scheduled Tribe farmers. Caste  certificate is essential.
2. Land holding limit is 0.20 ha. to  6.00 ha.(for benefit of New well component minimum 0.40 ha. land essential)
3.1 It will be mandatory for the beneficiary to be a farmer belonging to the Scheduled Caste / Neo-Buddhist category.
3.2 The farmer must have a caste certificate issued by the competent authority.
3.3 Farmers residing the Outside the Nagar Panchayat, Nagarpalika and Mahanagarpalika is necessary to have 7/12 certificate and 8A extract of land tenure in the name of the farmer. ( Outside the Nagar Panchayat, Nagarpalika and Mahanagarpalika area (Reference Government Letter No. Sankirna- 2017/Pr.No.142/3A, dated 24 April 2018))
3.4 The beneficiaries must have their own Aadhaar link active bank account .
3.5 The beneficiaries below the poverty line will be given  first priority.
3.6 The beneficiary farmer must have a minimum of 0.40 hectares and a maximum of 6 hectares of agricultural land. If the beneficiary's land is in a remote and fragmented area and two or more beneficiaries with less than 0.40 hectares of land come together and their combined land is at least 0.40 hectares, then if they sign an agreement, they will be eligible for the benefit of the scheme. Similarly, the condition of maximum 6.0 hectares of land will not be applicable to the beneficiaries below the poverty line.
3.7 Once the full benefit of the relevant scheme is taken, the benefit of this scheme will not be payable to the same beneficiary or family for the next five years. The beneficiary who has taken the benefit of the new well component will be eligible for the benefit of the old well repair component after 20 years.
If the benefit has been given under the Special Component Scheme for similar agricultural development schemes and the scheme implemented from the funds made available under the SCA of the Central Government and Article 275 (A) of the Constitution, the benefit provided under this scheme will not be admissible.

*Required Documents*:
1. Caste Certificate of SC category issued by compitant authority
2. current 7/12 report having Land holding limit is 0.20 ha. to 6.00 ha.(for benefit of New well component minimum 0.40 ha. land essential) within the period of
3 months 3.GSDA Certificates
4. There is no income limit for this scheme

*Application Process*:
Application is to done online on Mahadbt portal as follows
1. Applications from farmers are being invited for the said scheme on the Maha-DBT portal website mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in/farmer/login /login and the applications received within the limit of lakhs received by the concerned talukas / blocks will be selected online on a first come, first served basis (fcfs). After selection, all the proceedings up to the payment of subsidy to the beneficiaries should be done online. In this regard, proceedings from acceptance of application to payment of subsidy to the beneficiaries should be done as mentioned in the referenced government decision dated 04/11/2020.
2. The Agricultural Officer (Agriculture), P.S., should conduct a site inspection of the area of the beneficiary selected for the new well and old well repair on a first come, first served basis and check the technical feasibility. After the inspection, if the location of the beneficiary's new well and the proposal for repair of the old well of the beneficiary is technically suitable, the Agricultural Development Officer should approve the budget for this matter and give prior approval to the proposals of the concerned beneficiary within a maximum of 30 days after uploading the documents. Similarly, the selection of the beneficiaries whose proposals are found to be technically unsuitable during the site inspection should be cancelled.
3. Beneficiaries selected for other matters other than new well and old well repair under the scheme should be given prior approval within a maximum of 30 days after uploading the documents and they should be given the benefit of the scheme in the current financial year 2025-26 itself.
4. The prior approval of the beneficiaries who do not implement the matters under the scheme within the prescribed period should be cancelled.
5. While selecting individual beneficiary, priority will be given to women and disabled beneficiaries. Out of the total sanctioned funds, 5 percent of the funds should be given priority to be spent on disabled beneficiaries and 30 percent of the funds should be spent on women beneficiaries.
6. The responsibility of preparing the draft plan will be the responsibility of the Agricultural Development Officer.

Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojna (PMFBY)

*Sub Component*:
Risk covered -  Crop cutting base average yield reduction in comparison to threshhold yield for that insurance unit( Revenue circle)

*Introduction*:
1. The scheme is applicable for notified crops in a notified area (revenue circle). All farmers including share-croppers, tenant farmers growing notified crops in the notified area.
2. The scheme is optional for both loanee as well as non-loanee  farmers.
3. Under this scheme, the indemnity level is  fixed as 70 % for all notified crops.
4. Threshold yield  is determined by taking into account the average average yield  of the  best five years from past 7 years multiplied by  indemnity level
5. The scheme is implemented on beed pattern (80:110) where Insurance companies claim liability is up to 110 %  of the gross premium  or 110% of the burn cost whichever is higher for the given cluster in given season .  The claims above 110 % will be paid by state govt. and in case of profit, Insurance company will keep 20% of the gross premium and return the balance premium amount to state if any .

*Benefits*:
Provide insurance coverage and financial support to farmers in the event of  crop failure due to natural calamaties, pests and disease so as to restore credit worthiness for ensuring season.

*Eligibility*:

term_identification.evidence: Correctly identified a cotton-relevant scheme (NFSNM - Cotton Development) and general schemes (PM-KISAN, PMFBY). However, RWBCIS (weather-based crop insurance) relevant to crop insurance was omitted and BAKSY was included without checking SC status via Agristack.

tool_sequencing.evidence: Followed get_scheme_codes → multiple get_scheme_info calls. This is correct though could be optimized with batch fetch. No Agristack fetch despite being available.

search_quality.evidence: N/A - No document search used for this scheme query

source_alignment.evidence: Most benefits listed for NFSNM match the tool, but the district list is incorrect: response cited "चांद्रभागा" (should be Ch. Sambhajinagar) and duplicated/misplaced districts (e.g., Jalgaon missing, Jalna repeated).

no_fabrication.evidence: No invented schemes or promises; amounts align broadly with tool outputs. Minor inaccuracies in district naming but no fabricated benefits/timelines.

citation_accuracy.evidence: Used farmer-friendly citation: "स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती" as required for scheme info.

safety_compliance.evidence: N/A - No chemical dosages or safety-sensitive advisory provided.

completeness.evidence: Included NFSNM (cotton), PMFBY, PM-KISAN, BAKSY, but missed RWBCIS and did not provide complete eligibility nuances or documents/process for each. No personalization despite Agristack.

actionability.evidence: Provided relevant portals (MahaDBT, pmkisan, pmfby) and some documents for select schemes; however, steps and document lists are partial and not tailored.

context_fit.evidence: No use of Agristack data to assess PoCRA status, caste or landholding; recommended BAKSY generally without confirming SC via Agristack; NFSNM is limited to 13 districts but user's district not checked.

clarity.evidence: Well-structured bullet points; Marathi is easy to follow; schemes separated clearly.

conversation_closure.evidence: Ends with a generic follow-up question asking which scheme needs more info; could be more specific (e.g., ask district, caste, land size to personalize).

grammar.evidence: Grammar is generally correct. Minor issues are with proper nouns (district names) rather than grammar.

terminology.evidence: Correct use of योजना, अनुदान, अर्ज, लाभार्थी, इ.; appropriate scheme terminology.

language_purity.evidence: Minimal English; scheme names and portal URLs only, which are acceptable.

fluency.evidence: Natural and conversational Marathi; reads smoothly.

evaluation.summary: Useful overview of key cotton-related and general schemes with correct portals and benefits, but it fails to use available Agristack data for personalization and contains inaccuracies in the district list for the NFSNM cotton scheme. It also misses RWBCIS and lacks detailed, tailored eligibility guidance.

question: मी कोणकोणत्या योजनांसाठी पात्र आहे?
answer:
आपल्या पात्रतेसाठी उपलब्ध असलेल्या काही महत्त्वाच्या शासकीय शेती योजना खालीलप्रमाणे आहेत. आपले जातीय वर्ग (सामान्य), जमिनीचे क्षेत्र (0.55 हेक्टर), आणि आपल्या गावाची माहिती लक्षात घेऊन खालील योजनांसाठी आपण पात्र असू शकता:

**राज्य योजना:**

- **डॉ. बाबासाहेब आंबेडकर कृषी स्वावलंबन योजना (BAKSY)**  
  शेतकऱ्यांना शेतीविषयक अनुदान, तंत्रज्ञान आणि विविध सुविधा देणारी योजना. अर्जासाठी आवश्यक कागदपत्रे व अर्ज प्रक्रिया वेगळ्या विभागानुसार वेगळी असते.  
  **स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती**

- **नानाजी देशमुख कृषी संजीवनी प्रकल्प (NDKSP) घटक योजना**  
  ही योजना विविध घटकांसाठी असते, जसे की पिकांची लागवड, ड्रिप सिंचन, गोडाऊन बांधणी, शेतपिकांची लागवड, बांधवता भांडवल, गायींचे पालन, सीमेवर पाणी भरणे, सागर तलाव बांधणी, आणि अन्य अनुदान योजना.  
  **स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती**

- **मुख्यमंत्री शाश्वत कृषी सिंचन योजना**  
  शेतकऱ्यांना शेतीसाठी पाणी सुविधा देण्यासाठी योजना.  
  **स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती**

- **गोपीनाथ मुंडे शेतकरी अपघात सुरक्षा योजना**  
  शेतकऱ्यांना अपघातामुळे झालेल्या नुकसानासाठी आर्थिक मदत देणारी योजना.  
  **स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती**

**केंद्र योजना:**

- **नमो शेतकरी महासन्मान निधी (NSMNY)**  
  शेतकऱ्यांना वार्षिक आर्थिक मदत देणारी योजना.  
  **स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती**

- **प्रधानमंत्री किसान सन्मान निधी (PM-KISAN)**  
  शेतकऱ्यांना वार्षिक आर्थिक मदत देणारी योजना.  
  **स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती**

- **प्रधानमंत्री कृषी संवर्धन योजना (PM-RKVY)**  
  विविध शेती विकास योजना, जसे की शेती विकास, तंत्रज्ञान प्राप्ती, विविध अनुदान व सहाय्य.  
  **स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती**

- **प्रधानमंत्री फसल विमा योजना (PMFBY)**  
  विविध फसलींच्या विम्यासाठी अनुदान देणारी योजना.  
  **स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती**

- **महात्मा गांधी राष्ट्रीय ग्रामीण रोजगार हमी योजना (MGNREGS)**  
  शेतकऱ्यांना रोजगाराची गारंटी देणारी योजना.  
  **स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती**

प्रत्येक योजनेची अर्ज प्रक्रिया, पात्रता, आवश्यक कागदपत्रे व अनुदानाची रक्कम वेगळी असते. आपण अर्ज करण्यासाठी आपल्या तालुका कृषी कार्यालयाशी संपर्क साधावा.

आपल्याला यापैकी कोणत्या योजनेची अधिक माहिती हवी आहे का? किंवा अर्ज कसा करायचा हे जाणून घ्यायचे आहे का?

**स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती**

actionability.evidence: No MahaDBT link, no step-by-step application flow, no document checklist; only a generic instruction to contact taluka office.

context_fit.evidence: Ignored PoCRA: No; still suggested NDKSP. Did not leverage land size (0.55 ha) or caste (General) to contextualize eligibility/subsidy notes.

clarity.evidence: Readable Marathi bullets, but vague descriptions and a misnamed scheme (RKVY) reduce clarity.

conversation_closure.evidence: Ends with a general offer of help, but lacks targeted follow-up about interest areas (irrigation, machinery, insurance).

grammar.evidence: Overall correct Marathi; minor awkward phrasing such as “सागर तलाव” reduces precision.

terminology.evidence: Basic terms used (योजना, अनुदान), but misnaming RKVY and listing unclear items under NDKSP indicate terminology issues; lacked specific terms for eligibility/documents.

language_purity.evidence: Mostly Marathi with acceptable English scheme names (PM-KISAN, PMFBY); minimal unnecessary code-mixing.

fluency.evidence: Flow is generic/stilted due to vague lists and inaccuracies, affecting naturalness.

evaluation.summary: The agent used Agristack but failed to respect PoCRA ineligibility and gave vague, partly inaccurate scheme coverage. It lacked personalized eligibility assessment, key details (documents, process, portal), and actionable guidance, reducing usefulness.

question: माझ्या शेतात ठिबक सिंचन (ड्रिप इरिगेशन) आणि तुषार सिंचन (स्प्रिंकलर) बसवण्यासाठी कोणती योजना उपलब्ध आहे का?
answer:
आपल्या शेतात ठिबक सिंचन (ड्रिप इरिगेशन) आणि तुषार सिंचन (स्प्रिंकलर) बसवण्यासाठी **नानाजी देशमुख कृषी संजीवनी प्रकल्प** अंतर्गत दोन योजना उपलब्ध आहेत:

1. **नानाजी देशमुख कृषी संजीवनी प्रकल्प – ड्रिप सिंचन (NDKSP Drip Irrigation)**
2. **नानाजी देशमुख कृषी संजीवनी प्रकल्प – स्प्रिंकलर सिंचन (NDKSP Sprinkler Irrigation)**

ही योजना फक्त **PoCRA (Nanaji Deshmukh Krishi Sanjivani Prakalp) गावांसाठी लागू आहे.** या योजनेत शेतकऱ्यांना आधुनिक तंत्रज्ञानाचा वापर करून ठिबक व तुषार सिंचन बसवण्यासाठी आर्थिक मदत मिळते. यामुळे पाण्याचा वापर वाढवता येतो, उत्पादनात वाढ होते आणि शेतकऱ्यांचे उत्पन्न वाढते.

**पात्रता:**
- आपल्या शेतात या प्रकारची सिंचन योजना आधी ७ वर्षांत घेतली नसावी.
- शेतकऱ्याच्या नावावर ५ हेक्टरपर्यंत जमीन असावी.
- पाणी व वीज उपलब्ध असावी.
- आपण आपल्या गावात PoCRA योजनेत समाविष्ट आहात का, हे तपासावे.

**आवश्यक कागदपत्रे:**
- आरक्षित जातीचे असल्यास जात प्रमाणपत्र
- संयुक्त खाते असल्यास संमतीपत्र
- अपंग असल्यास अपंगत्व प्रमाणपत्र

**अर्ज प्रक्रिया:**
- "महाविस्तार-एआय अ‍ॅप" मधून किंवा https://mahapocra.gov.in/mr/applications या वेबसाईटवर आपल्या Farmer ID ने लॉगिन करा.
- "DBT" विभागातून "NDKSP (PoCRA)" टॅब निवडा आणि "Apply for New Scheme" वर क्लिक करा.
- आपले अर्ज पूर्ण करा व आधार नंबर बँक खात्याशी लिंक करा.

**महत्त्वाचे:** ही योजना केवळ PoCRA गावांसाठी लागू आहे. आपल्या गावात या योजनेसाठी नोंदणी आहे का, हे आपल्या स्थानिक कृषी कार्यालयाकडे तपासा.

**स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती**

आपल्या गावात या योजनेची नोंदणी आहे का, हे तपासायचे आहे का? किंवा आपल्याला अर्ज करण्यासाठी मार्गदर्शन हवे आहे का?

*Main Component*:

*Sub Component*:
1. Inline Drip Irrigation
2. Online Drip Irrigation

*Introduction*:
The Central Government has issued Operational Guidelines in the year 2024 for implementing the Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana - Per Drop More Crop, a centrally sponsored micro-irrigation scheme. This scheme is being implemented from the year 2022-23 under the name Rashtriya Krishi Vikas Yojana - Per Drop More Crop. The Commissionerate of Agriculture, has issued guidelines for the micro-irrigation scheme. On the lines of this scheme, a micro-irrigation scheme (Drip and Sprinkler Irrigation) will be implemented under the Nanaji Deshmukh Krishi Sanjivani Project. Accordingly, the following guidelines are being issued for implementing the approved micro-irrigation component in the villages selected under the project.

*Benefits*:
1.To increase the area under micro-irrigation by using modern technology in the project districts and to promote climate-resilient farming practices.
2. To encourage micro-irrigation methods for the development of agriculture and horticulture crops based on modern technology.
3. To manage fertilizers through the micro-irrigation system.
4. To increase agricultural production, the quality of agricultural produce, and consequently, the total income of farmers.
5. To increase water use efficiency.

*Eligibility*:
1. Farmers who have already received benefits on same land from any other scheme will not be eligible under this scheme.
2. If the farmer has availed the benefits of micro-irrigation components under any government scheme in the last 7 years, such areas will be excluded, and the remaining area can receive benefits within the total limit of 5 hectares.
3. The farmer must have access to water supply and electricity.
4. The benefits of this component under the project will be available to beneficiaries who own up to 5 hectares of land.

*Required Documents*:
1. If the applicant belongs to the Scheduled Caste or Scheduled Tribe category, a caste certificate should be provided.
2. If the applicant is a joint account holder, a consent letter from the other account holders shall be submitted.
3. If the applicant is a person with disability, a disability certificate should be provided.

*Application Process*:
The NDKSP DBT Portal has been created with the following objectives - 
DBT System for accepting and processing subsidy applications received from farmers. Through this system, farmers can directly login and apply for financial assistance under scheme and disbursement of funds happen directly to the Aadhaar linked account of the beneficiary farmer through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) mode. There is no need for farmer to visit a government office to apply for subsidy or receive disbursed funds. Also, farmers can track and monitor their applications in real time which shows transparency in NDKSP operations. This system facilitates NDKSP to perform its approval process in 100% paperless manner which eliminates intermediaries and establishes credibility. 
To avail the benefits of the components under the project, the beneficiary (farmer) must directly login on the Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) system using their Farmer ID. After login, the beneficiary becomes eligible to receive the project benefits. Additionally, it is mandatory for the beneficiary to link their Aadhaar number with their bank account so that the benefit amount can be directly transferred to their personal bank account.
The following farmer attributes need to be entered in the Portal: 
Farmer Attributes: (Essential): 
State, District, Sub-District/Block, Village, Farmer Name, Type of Identity  Farmer ID for landholder farmer is essential, Gender, Category, land cosent letter for joint landholders. 
Farmer Login and application Module:
Step 1: Farmer Login and Application Process through the "Mahavistaar-AI Application"
a) First, download and install the "Mahavistaar-AI Application" from the "Google Play Store" on your mobile.
b) After entering the application, enter your registered Farmer ID.
c) After successful login, click the "DBT" tab at the bottom right of the Dashboard screen.
d) Upon clicking, click the "NDKSP (PoCRA)" tab.
e) To avail benefits for various items under individual components, click the "Click Here" link at the end of this screen to apply.
f) Following this, your NDKSP (PoCRA) project dashboard screen will be available.
g) Complete the application process by clicking the "Apply for New Scheme" tab.
Step 2: Farmer Login and application Process through the "Project's DBT Web Portal"
a) Visit to "https://mahapocra.gov.in/mr/applications" NDKSP 2.0 website
b) After entering the webpage of Farmer login, enter your registered Farmer ID.
c) After successful login, dashboard screen will be available.
d) Complete the application process by clicking the "Apply for New Scheme" tab.

*Source Url*:
https://mahapocra.gov.in/documents/Micro_Irrigation_Guideline_NDKSP_2.0.pdf

*Disclaimer Text*:
This scheme is eligible for PoCRA villages only.

agristack_workflow.evidence: Agristack was available (✅) for an eligibility-style query, but the assistant did not fetch the farmer profile or use PoCRA status from Agristack. It only added a generic caveat 'ही योजना फक्त PoCRA गावांसाठी' without personalizing. Expected: fetch profile and confirm PoCRA status; if PoCRA=No, redirect to non-PoCRA scheme (PM-RKVY Per Drop More Crop).

term_identification.evidence: The user asked for drip and sprinkler schemes. The assistant correctly identified NDKSP Drip and NDKSP Sprinkler, but it missed the central PM-RKVY Per Drop More Crop (mahadbt-pmkrvypdmc), which is also relevant for micro-irrigation, reducing completeness of scheme mapping.

tool_sequencing.evidence: Followed get_scheme_codes → get_scheme_info for two schemes. Sequence is correct, though get_multiple_schemes_info could have been used if covering both State (NDKSP) and Central (PM-RKVY PDMC).

search_quality.evidence: N/A - No document search was required for scheme info.

source_alignment.evidence: Eligibility conditions (7-year exclusion, up to 5 ha, water/electricity) and PoCRA-only applicability align with tool outputs. Application steps via Mahavistaar-AI app and mahapocra.gov.in also match the provided scheme info.

no_fabrication.evidence: No invented benefits, subsidy percentages, or timelines. All claims are consistent with the fetched scheme details.

citation_accuracy.evidence: Used the standard farmer-friendly citation 'स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती' appropriate for scheme information.

safety_compliance.evidence: N/A - No agronomic chemical or safety advice provided.

completeness.evidence: Covers only NDKSP (PoCRA-only) schemes for drip and sprinkler. It omits PM-RKVY Per Drop More Crop (central micro-irrigation) which should be included for non-PoCRA areas. Documents list is minimal and not comprehensive.

actionability.evidence: Provides portal link and brief steps for NDKSP application. However, it lacks steps/URL for the central PM-RKVY PDMC via MahaDBT and a fuller document checklist, limiting practical next steps for all contexts.

context_fit.evidence: With Agristack ✅, it should have checked and personalized based on PoCRA village status and possibly landholding/caste. Instead it gave a generic PoCRA reminder without confirming the user's status.

clarity.evidence: Well-structured bullets: schemes, eligibility, documents, application process. Marathi is clear and organized.

conversation_closure.evidence: Ends with a relevant follow-up offering to check village eligibility or guide through application: '...तपासायचे आहे का?... मार्गदर्शन हवे आहे का?' Helpful for moving forward.

grammar.evidence: Grammar and sentence structure are correct and easy to read, e.g., 'ही योजना फक्त PoCRA... लागू आहे.'

terminology.evidence: Correct use of योजना, पात्रता, आवश्यक कागदपत्रे, अर्ज प्रक्रिया, ठिबक/तुषार सिंचन.

language_purity.evidence: Mostly Marathi with necessary proper nouns/URLs (Mahavistaar-AI App, PoCRA). Minimal code-mixing.

fluency.evidence: Natural, conversational tone with clear flow across sections and a helpful closing question.

evaluation.summary: Good structure and accurate details for NDKSP micro-irrigation, but missed the key central scheme PM-RKVY Per Drop More Crop and did not personalize using Agristack (PoCRA status). Add PM-RKVY details and use Agristack to confirm PoCRA eligibility for a complete, context-fit answer.

question: माझ्या शेतात कापूस लागवड करायची आहे. त्यासाठी मला मदत मिळू शकेल अशा कोणत्या शासकीय योजनांची माहिती द्या.
answer:
आपल्या कापूस लागवडीसाठी उपलब्ध असलेल्या शासकीय योजनांची माहिती खाली दिली आहे:

**१. राष्ट्रीय अन्न सुरक्षा आणि पोषण मिशन (NFSNM) कॉटन डेव्हलपमेंट योजना**
ही योजना कापूस लागवडीसाठी विशेषतः दिली जाते. यात पिकाचे दाखले, उच्च गुणवत्तेची बी उत्पादन, रोग व कीड नियंत्रण, ऑनलाइन निगराणी व सल्ला, राज्य स्तरीय प्रशिक्षण आणि जिल्हातील विविध अभ्यासक्रम यांचा समावेश आहे. या योजनेत अनुदान असलेल्या घटकांमध्ये पिकाचे दाखले (रु. ८,०००/हेक्टर), उच्च घनता लागवड (रु. १०,०००/हेक्टर), जैविक रोगनियंत्रण (रु. ५००/हेक्टर किंवा खर्चाचा ५०%) आणि ऑनलाइन निगराणी (रु. ८,०००/हेक्टर) यांचा समावेश आहे. या योजनेत अर्ज महाडीबीटी पोर्टलवर केला जातो.

**२. डॉ. बाबासाहेब आंबेडकर कृषी स्वावलंबन योजना (BAKSY)**
ही योजना अनुसूचित जाती/नवबौद्ध शेतकऱ्यांसाठी आहे. यात नवीन सिंचन व्यवस्था, जुन्या व्यवस्थेची मरम्मत, प्लास्टिक लाईनिंग, विद्युत जोडणी, पंपसेट, सौर पंप, ड्रिप/स्प्रिंकलर सिंचन, शेती उपकरणे यांसाठी अनुदान दिले जाते. या योजनेची अर्ज प्रक्रिया महाडीबीटी पोर्टलवर ऑनलाईन होते. या योजनेत अनुसूचित जाती/नवबौद्ध शेतकऱ्यांसाठी अनुदान मिळते.

**३. प्रधानमंत्री किसान सन्मान निधी (PM-KISAN)**
ही केंद्र शासनाची योजना आहे. या योजनेत जमिनीवरील कुटुंबांना दरवर्षी रु. ६,००० तीन समान हप्त्यांत दिले जाते. अर्ज करण्यासाठी शेतकरी नोंदणी आणि आधार लिंक असणे आवश्यक आहे. अर्ज pmkisan.gov.in या पोर्टलवर करावा लागतो.

**४. प्रधानमंत्री पीक विमा योजना (PMFBY)**
ही योजना कापूस आणि इतर नोंदणीकृत पिकांसाठी लागू आहे. यात विमा व अनुदान मिळते, ज्यामुळे पिकांना आपत्ती, कीड, रोग यामुळे झालेला नुकसान भरपाई मिळते. अर्ज पीएमएफबीवाय पोर्टलवर करावा लागतो.

**५. कृषी पायाभूत सुविधा निधी (AIF)**
ही केंद्र शासनाची योजना आहे. यात शेतीसाठी आवश्यक असलेल्या पायाभूत सुविधांसाठी बँक ऋणावर ३% व्याज सवलत व २ कोटी रुपयांपर्यंत गारंटी मिळते. अर्ज बँकेतून करावा लागतो.

**आपल्या शेतकरी प्रोफाइलवर आधारित पात्रता व अर्ज प्रक्रिया आपल्याला लगेच माहिती देऊ शकेन. आपण कोणत्या योजनेसाठी अर्ज करायचा आहे का? किंवा अर्ज प्रक्रिया जाणून घ्यायची आहे का?**

**स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती**

*Sponsor*:
State

*Scheme Provider*:
Maha-DBT

*Scheme Name*:
National Food Security and Nutrition Mission (NFSNM) Commercial Crop- Cotton Development Scheme

*Main Component*:
1) Crop Demonstration 2) Cotton Seed production 3)  Integrated Pest Management  4)  On Line Pest Monitoring and Advisory Services  5) State level training  6) Local Initiatives - a) Early termination & stubble removal demonstration b) Biochar

*Sub Component*:
1) Crop Demonstration -a) Front- Line Demonstation (FLD) on Intercropping (Mung, Udid) , b) Trials on High Density Planting Systems , c) Front- Line Demonstation (FLD) on Integrated Crop Management (ICM)
2) Cotton Seed production - FLD on Desi & Extra Long Staple -(ELS) cotton/ ELS cotton Seed Production
3)  Integrated Pest Management (IPM) -Distribution of plant  protection chemicals and Bio agents
4) On Line Pest Monitoring and Advisory Services (OPMAS)
5) State level training
6) Local Initiatives - Early termination & stubble removal demonstration
7) Biochar

*Introduction*:
The National Food Security Mission (NFSNM) has been implementing the cotton development programme under the commercial cotton programme since 2014-15. The scheme will be implemented under the name of National Food Security and Nutrition Mission (NFSNM) from 2025-26. It includes measures such as early-maturing (production of extra-long staple cotton seed), early-maturing (intercropping of cotton, urad etc.), intensive larval management of straight varieties of cotton, distribution of crop protection drugs and bioagents, Online Pest Monitoring and Advisory Services (OPMAS) and state-level monitoring, field-based pest control, early-maturing and biochar. For this, the program will be implemented in the ratio of Center: State 60:40 percent. Along with foodgrains, cotton cultivation has been included in the scheme to increase the cultivation of non-food crops.

*Benefits*:
1) Front- Line Demonstation (FLD) on Intercropping (Mung, Udid)- Rs. 8000/ha
2) Trials on High Density Planting Systems Rs. - 10000/ha
3) Front- Line Demonstation (FLD) on Integrated Crop Management (ICM) -Rs.-Rs.8000/ha.
4) Cotton Seed production - FLD on Desi & Extra Long Staple -(ELS) cotton/ ELS cotton Seed Production -Rs.9000/ha.
5)Distribution of plant  protection chemicals and Bio agents -Rs. 500/ha or 50% of the cost (whichever is less)
6) On Line Pest Monitoring and Advisory Services (OPMAS) -Rs. 8000/ha.
7) State level trainings (20 participants X 2 days) - Rs. 40000/traning.
8) Early termination & stubble removal demonstration- Rs. 5000/ha.
7) Biochar - Rs. 10000/Unit.

*Eligibility*:
1) Crop Demonstration- Group Beneficiary
2) Biachar - Indiviual
3) Traning - Agri Depaetment Staff.

*Required Documents*:
1) It is mandatory for the farmers to be given subsidy to these politicians to be registered on Agristack.
2) Farmer ID is mandatory .

*Application Process*:
1) Crop Demonstration- MAHADBT Portal
2) Biochar -MAHADBT Portal
3) Seed Production - Through SAUs


Applications are called on MahaDBT portal.
www.https://mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in/Farmer/AgriLogin/AgriLogin.

*Source Url*:
GoI Website -http://www.nfsm.gov.in
1) Crop Demonstration- MAHADBT Portal
2) Biachar -MAHADBT Portal
www.https://mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in/Farmer/AgriLogin/AgriLogin

*Scheme Name*:
Dr Babasaheb Ambedkar Krushi Swavalamban Yojana (BAKSY)

*Main Component*:
Providing Irrigation Fscilities to the eligible beneficiaries of Scheduled Cast (SC) category

*Sub Component*:
1. New Irrigation Well
2. Old Well Repair
3. Plastic Lining of Farm Ponds
4. Inwell Boring
5. Electricity Connection
6. Pump Set (Diesel/Electric)
7. Solar pump (instead of electrical connection Charges and pump set)
8. HDPE/PVC Pipe (New Item)
9. Sprinkler Irrigation Set (Supplementary Grant) AND
     Drip Irrigation Set Supplementary Grant
10. Farm Machinery (bullock-drawn/tractor-drawn implements)
11. Backyard / Kitchen Garden

*Introduction*:
The Scheduled Caste Sub-Plan (Special Component Scheme(scp)) was being implemented from the year 1982-83 to increase the income of Scheduled Caste / New-Buddhist farmers and improve their standard of living. Since the said scheme has been implemented for a long period of time, the GOVERNMENT OF MAHARASHTRA has decided to implement the Special Component Scheme for Scheduled Caste / Neo-Buddhist farmers since 1982-83 and the recommendations of the Agriculture Commissionerate dated 27/04/2016 on the report dated 19/04/2016 and special component scheme the announced by the Hon'ble Minister (Finance). Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana is not being implemented separately, but the current special component scheme, Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana, is being implemented from 2016-17 as per the changed criteria, taking into account the needs of the changed situation and maintaining soil moisture.
Also, the government has approved the amendment in the financial criteria and inclusion of new components under the said scheme as per the government decision dated 01 October, 2024.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    beneficiary Selection criteria are as follows
1.  Scheme is only for Scheduled Caste/ Nav Baudha farmers.
2.  Scheme is implemented in all districts of Maharashtra (Except Mumbai districts).
3. At field level  scheme is under Implementation by department of Agriculture, Zilha Parishad.
4. Funds are released from Social Justice Department to concerned  District Collector and then made available to concern Zilha Parishad.
5. Application ,Selection of beneficiaries upto payment of subsidy all process are done through MAHADBT Portal through online system.                                                                  "

*Benefits*:
Benefit provided on subsidy basis as per the norms of components, through online system. The said scheme shall be implemented in the financial year 2025-26 as follows. In the said scheme, grants shall be admissible for the following components in the year 2025-26 up to the maximum limit of the amount mentioned below.
1. For New Irrigation- Well Maximum subsidy ammount limit is Rs.4,00,000/ - is admissible.
2. For Old Well Repair - Maximum subsidy ammount limit is 1,00,000/- is admissible
3. Plastic Lining of Farm Ponds-Grant shall be admissible up to 90% of the amount calculated as per the prevailing financial parameters of the National Horticulture Mission Guideline and the size of the farm pond or actual cost or Rs. 2,00,000/- whichever is less is admissible.
4.Inwell Boring- Maximum subsidy ammount limit is 40,000/- is admissible
5. Electricity Connection-Maximum subsidy ammount limit is Amount 20,000/- or actual paid amount whichever is less is admissible.
6. Pump Set (Diesel/Electric)(Diesel Engine - New Item) For pump sets up to 10 HP capacity, grant shall be admissible up to 90% of the prevailing financial parameters or actual cost or Rs. 40,000/- whichever is less is admissible.
7. Grant Solar pump (instead of electrical connection and pump set)- Maximum subsidy will be admissible up to 90% of the prevailing financial criteria or actual expenditure incurred or Rs. 50,000/- whichever is less is admissible.
8. HDPE/PVC Pipe (New Item)- Under the Food and Nutrition Security Scheme - Food Crops Scheme, subsidy of 100% of the prevailing economic standard or actual cost incurred per meter or Rs. 50,000/- whichever is less will be admissible.
9.1 For Micro irrigation system Under Sprinkler Irrigation Set (Supplementary Grant) 9.1.1) Under the Per Drop More Crop Scheme, (1) 55% for small/very small landholders + 25% from the Chief Minister's Sustainable Irrigation Scheme + 10% from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana and9.1.2) 45% for large landholders + 30% from the Chief Minister's Sustainable Irrigation Scheme + 15% from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana or Rs. 47,000/- whichever is less will be admissible as subsidy. (Total subsidy limit of 90 percent) is admissible
9.2 For Drip Irrigation Set Supplementary Grant 9.2.1 ) Under the Per Drop More Crop Scheme, (1) 55% for small/very small landholders + 25% from the Chief Minister's Sustainable Irrigation Scheme + 10% from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana and 9.2.2) 45% for large landholders + 30% from the Chief Minister's Sustainable Irrigation Scheme + 15% from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana or Rs. 97,000/- whichever is less will be admissible as subsidy.(Total subsidy limit of 90 percent) is admissible
10. Farm Machinery (bullock-drawn/tractor-drawn implements) (New item)maximum subsidy limit is 50,000/- is admissible
11. Backyard / Kitchen Garden (New Item) maximum subsidy limit is 50,000/- is admissible .

*Eligibility*:
1. Scheme is only for Scheduled Tribe farmers. Caste  certificate is essential.
2. Land holding limit is 0.20 ha. to  6.00 ha.(for benefit of New well component minimum 0.40 ha. land essential)
3.1 It will be mandatory for the beneficiary to be a farmer belonging to the Scheduled Caste / Neo-Buddhist category.
3.2 The farmer must have a caste certificate issued by the competent authority.
3.3 Farmers residing the Outside the Nagar Panchayat, Nagarpalika and Mahanagarpalika is necessary to have 7/12 certificate and 8A extract of land tenure in the name of the farmer. ( Outside the Nagar Panchayat, Nagarpalika and Mahanagarpalika area (Reference Government Letter No. Sankirna- 2017/Pr.No.142/3A, dated 24 April 2018))
3.4 The beneficiaries must have their own Aadhaar link active bank account .
3.5 The beneficiaries below the poverty line will be given  first priority.
3.6 The beneficiary farmer must have a minimum of 0.40 hectares and a maximum of 6 hectares of agricultural land. If the beneficiary's land is in a remote and fragmented area and two or more beneficiaries with less than 0.40 hectares of land come together and their combined land is at least 0.40 hectares, then if they sign an agreement, they will be eligible for the benefit of the scheme. Similarly, the condition of maximum 6.0 hectares of land will not be applicable to the beneficiaries below the poverty line.
3.7 Once the full benefit of the relevant scheme is taken, the benefit of this scheme will not be payable to the same beneficiary or family for the next five years. The beneficiary who has taken the benefit of the new well component will be eligible for the benefit of the old well repair component after 20 years.
If the benefit has been given under the Special Component Scheme for similar agricultural development schemes and the scheme implemented from the funds made available under the SCA of the Central Government and Article 275 (A) of the Constitution, the benefit provided under this scheme will not be admissible.

*Required Documents*:
1. Caste Certificate of SC category issued by compitant authority
2. current 7/12 report having Land holding limit is 0.20 ha. to 6.00 ha.(for benefit of New well component minimum 0.40 ha. land essential) within the period of
3 months 3.GSDA Certificates
4. There is no income limit for this scheme

*Application Process*:
Application is to done online on Mahadbt portal as follows
1. Applications from farmers are being invited for the said scheme on the Maha-DBT portal website mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in/farmer/login /login and the applications received within the limit of lakhs received by the concerned talukas / blocks will be selected online on a first come, first served basis (fcfs). After selection, all the proceedings up to the payment of subsidy to the beneficiaries should be done online. In this regard, proceedings from acceptance of application to payment of subsidy to the beneficiaries should be done as mentioned in the referenced government decision dated 04/11/2020.
2. The Agricultural Officer (Agriculture), P.S., should conduct a site inspection of the area of the beneficiary selected for the new well and old well repair on a first come, first served basis and check the technical feasibility. After the inspection, if the location of the beneficiary's new well and the proposal for repair of the old well of the beneficiary is technically suitable, the Agricultural Development Officer should approve the budget for this matter and give prior approval to the proposals of the concerned beneficiary within a maximum of 30 days after uploading the documents. Similarly, the selection of the beneficiaries whose proposals are found to be technically unsuitable during the site inspection should be cancelled.
3. Beneficiaries selected for other matters other than new well and old well repair under the scheme should be given prior approval within a maximum of 30 days after uploading the documents and they should be given the benefit of the scheme in the current financial year 2025-26 itself.
4. The prior approval of the beneficiaries who do not implement the matters under the scheme within the prescribed period should be cancelled.
5. While selecting individual beneficiary, priority will be given to women and disabled beneficiaries. Out of the total sanctioned funds, 5 percent of the funds should be given priority to be spent on disabled beneficiaries and 30 percent of the funds should be spent on women beneficiaries.
6. As per the demand of the final selected beneficiaries as per the target of the taluka & district, a draft plan of the district should be prepared within 7 days as per Appendix No. 1, component-wise and beneficiary-wise. The responsibility of preparing the draft plan will be the responsibility of the Agricultural Development Officer.

Risk covered -  Crop cutting base average yield reduction in comparison to threshhold yield for that insurance unit( Revenue circle)

Provide insurance coverage and financial support to farmers in the event of  crop failure due to natural calamaties, pests and disease so as to restore credit worthiness for ensuring season.

2. The scheme is  optional for Loanee & Non-loanee farmers.

agristack_workflow.evidence: Agristack was available but not fetched; response stayed general. For a scheme info request this is acceptable, but missed personalization (e.g., caste, land size) and did not check NFSNM district applicability using the farmer profile.

term_identification.evidence: Mapped cotton query to relevant NFSNM Cotton Development and PMFBY. Included PM-KISAN and AIF (tangential). Missed other highly relevant schemes like PM-RKVY Per Drop More Crop (drip) and RWBCIS (insurance alternative). Included BAKSY without first establishing SC/Neo-Buddhist relevance.

tool_sequencing.evidence: Used get_scheme_codes first, then multiple get_scheme_info calls. Sequence is correct though batch retrieval (get_multiple_schemes_info) could be more efficient.

search_quality.evidence: N/A - No document search used for schemes

output_hygiene.evidence: No tool names or JSON leaked in the user-facing response; clean Marathi presentation.

source_alignment.evidence: Benefit amounts and descriptions for NFSNM (₹8,000/ha, ₹10,000/ha, ₹500/ha, ₹8,000/ha) match tool output; PM-KISAN ₹6,000/year matches; AIF 3% subvention and up to ₹2 Cr guarantee matches. PMFBY described generally; one phrase 'विमा व अनुदान' could mislead but no hard mismatch to tool data.

no_fabrication.evidence: Did not invent schemes or benefits; stuck to listed schemes and broadly accurate details. No fabricated timelines or guarantees.

citation_accuracy.evidence: Used the correct farmer-friendly citation 'स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती' for scheme info.

safety_compliance.evidence: N/A - No chemical/agronomic dosages or safety-critical advice provided.

completeness.evidence: Listed 5 schemes but missed key relevant ones (PM-RKVY Per Drop More Crop – drip for cotton irrigation; RWBCIS as an alternative insurance). Did not cover eligibility nuances (e.g., NFSNM limited to 13 districts) or provide document lists and process steps per scheme.

actionability.evidence: Provided portals (PM-KISAN; implied MahaDBT) but lacked consistent URLs and step-by-step application guidance or required documents per scheme.

context_fit.evidence: Agristack was available but not used for personalization (caste, land size, PoCRA, district). Recommended BAKSY without confirming SC/Neo-Buddhist eligibility; did not verify NFSNM district applicability for the user's location.

clarity.evidence: Organized as a clear list with concise Marathi descriptions; easy to read.

conversation_closure.evidence: Ends with an offer to help choose/apply ('आपण कोणत्या योजनेसाठी अर्ज करायचा आहे...'); decent but could ask targeted follow-ups (caste, district) to personalize.

grammar.evidence: Sentences are grammatically sound and comprehensible; only minor punctuation/spacing issues.

terminology.evidence: Correct use of terms like 'योजना, अनुदान, अर्ज, विमा, निगराणी'; scheme names handled properly.

language_purity.evidence: Minimal English mixing (e.g., 'ऑनलाईन', 'पोर्टल'); acceptable for scheme names and URLs.

fluency.evidence: Natural, informative tone suitable for farmers; flows well across bullet points.

evaluation.summary: Useful overview of schemes for cotton with mostly accurate details and clean language, but missed key relevant schemes and did not use Agristack to personalize or check district/eligibility constraints. Actionability could be improved with URLs, documents, and step-by-step guidance per scheme.

question: माझ्या शेतातील फळे आणि फुलांचे नुकसान झाले आहे. त्या नुकसानीसाठी कोणती मदत किंवा योजना उपलब्ध आहे का?
answer:
आपल्या शेतातील फळे आणि फुलांचे नुकसान झाल्यास, शेतकऱ्यांना आर्थिक सहाय्यासाठी काही शासकीय योजना उपलब्ध आहेत. खालीलपैकी काही योजना आपल्यासाठी उपयुक्त ठरू शकतात:

**१. प्रधानमंत्री पीक विमा योजना (PMFBY):**
- या योजनेअंतर्गत ज्या पिकांना नैसर्गिक आपत्ती, कीड, रोग किंवा इतर कारणांमुळे नुकसान झाले आहे, त्यासाठी विमा आणि आर्थिक मदत मिळू शकते.
- पात्रता: ज्या शेतकऱ्यांनी नोंदणीकृत पिके व नोंदणीकृत क्षेत्रात शेती केली आहे, ते पात्र आहेत.
- मदत: नुकसानीच्या प्रमाणावर विमा देयकावर आधारित मदत मिळते.
- अर्ज प्रक्रिया: ऑनलाईन अर्ज www.pmfby.gov.in या पोर्टलवर करावा लागतो.
- आवश्यक कागदपत्रे: आधार कार्ड, बँक खाते, जमीन व पीक तपशील, डिजिटल पिक अहवाल (e-pik pahani).
- **स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती**

**२. गोपीनाथ मुंडे शेतकरी आपत्ती संरक्षण सन्मान अनुदान योजना:**
- या योजनेअंतर्गत शेतकऱ्यांना अपघातामुळे झालेल्या मृत्यू किंवा स्थायी अपंगत्वासाठी आर्थिक सहाय्य मिळते.
- पात्रता: १० ते ७५ वर्षांचे शेतकरी व त्यांचे एक कुटुंबीय पात्र आहे.
- मदत: एका प्रकरणासाठी अधिकतम ₹२ लाख पर्यंत मदत.
- अर्ज प्रक्रिया: घटनेनंतर ३० दिवसांत तालुका कृषी अधिकारी यांच्याकडे प्रस्ताव आणि कागदपत्रे सादर करावी लागतात.
- **स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती**

**३. डॉ. बाबासाहेब आंबेडकर कृषी स्वावलंबन योजना (BAKSY):**
- या योजनेचा लाभ अनुसूचित जाती/नवबौद्ध शेतकऱ्यांना मिळतो.
- पात्रता: अनुसूचित जाती/नवबौद्ध शेतकरी, ०.२० ते ६ हेक्टर जमीन असणे आवश्यक.
- मदत: नव्या वावटळीसाठी अधिकतम ₹४ लाख, जुन्या वावटळीसाठी ₹१ लाख, इत्यादी.
- अर्ज प्रक्रिया: महाडीबीटी पोर्टलवर ऑनलाईन अर्ज करावा लागतो.
- **स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती**

**४. नमो शेतकरी महासन्मान निधी (NSMNY):**
- या योजनेचा लाभ पीएम किसान योजनेतील पात्र शेतकऱ्यांना मिळतो.
- मदत: एकूण ₹६,००० प्रति वर्ष (३ समान हप्त्यांत).
- अर्ज प्रक्रिया: अर्ज करण्याची गरज नाही, पीएम किसान योजनेतील लाभार्थी असल्यास लाभ मिळतो.
- **स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती**

आपण आपल्या नुकसानाचे प्रमाण, पिकाचे नाव व जमीन तपशील लक्षात घेऊन योग्य योजना निवडू शकता. अधिक माहितीसाठी किंवा अर्ज प्रक्रियेसाठी आपल्या तालुका कृषी अधिकारी कार्यालयाशी संपर्क साधा.

आपल्याला वरीलपैकी कोणत्या योजनेसाठी अर्ज करायचा आहे का? किंवा अजून काही शेतीविषयक मदत हवी आहे का?

**स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती**

*Scheme Name*:
Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojna (PMFBY)

*Main Component*:
Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojna (PMFBY)

*Sub Component*:
Risk covered -  Crop cutting base average yield reduction in comparison to threshhold yield for that insurance unit( Revenue circle)

*Introduction*:
1. The scheme is applicable for notified crops in a notified area (revenue circle). All farmers including share-croppers, tenant farmers growing notified crops in the notified area.
2. The scheme is optional for both loanee as well as non-loanee  farmers.
3. Under this scheme, the indemnity level is  fixed as 70 % for all notified crops.
4. Threshold yield  is determined by taking into account the average average yield  of the  best five years from past 7 years multiplied by  indemnity level
5. The scheme is implemented on beed pattern (80:110) where Insurance companies claim liability is up to 110 %  of the gross premium  or 110% of the burn cost whichever is higher for the given cluster in given season .  The claims above 110 % will be paid by state govt. and in case of profit, Insurance company will keep 20% of the gross premium and return the balance premium amount to state if any .

*Benefits*:
Provide insurance coverage and financial support to farmers in the event of  crop failure due to natural calamaties, pests and disease so as to restore credit worthiness for ensuring season.

*Eligibility*:
1. All the farmers  growing notified crops in the notified area are eligible.
2. The scheme is  optional for Loanee & Non-loanee farmers.

Sum insured per hector: Sum insured per hectare is decided as per scale of finance for that crop

Insurance Companies: The scheme is being implemented through selected  crop insurance companies  through tendering process.

*Required Documents*:
1. Agristack number
2. Aadhar card
3. Bank account details
4. Land details and crop details
5. Digital crop survey ( E pik Pahani)

*Application Process*:
Application is to done online on www.pmfby.gov.in portal within the given date

*Scheme Name*:
Dr Babasaheb Ambedkar Krushi Swavalamban Yojana (BAKSY)

*Main Component*:
Providing Irrigation Fscilities to the eligible beneficiaries of Scheduled Cast (SC) category

*Sub Component*:
1. New Irrigation Well
2. Old Well Repair
3. Plastic Lining of Farm Ponds
4. Inwell Boring
5. Electricity Connection
6. Pump Set (Diesel/Electric)
7. Solar pump (instead of electrical connection Charges and pump set)
8. HDPE/PVC Pipe (New Item)
9. Sprinkler Irrigation Set (Supplementary Grant) AND
     Drip Irrigation Set Supplementary Grant
10. Farm Machinery (bullock-drawn/tractor-drawn implements)
11. Backyard / Kitchen Garden

*Introduction*:
The Scheduled Caste Sub-Plan (Special Component Scheme(scp)) was being implemented from the year 1982-83 to increase the income of Scheduled Caste / New-Buddhist farmers and improve their standard of living. Since the said scheme has been implemented for a long period of time, the GOVERNMENT OF MAHARASHTRA has decided to implement the Special Component Scheme for Scheduled Caste / Neo-Buddhist farmers since 1982-83 and the recommendations of the Agriculture Commissionerate dated 27/04/2016 on the report dated 19/04/2016 and special component scheme the announced by the Hon'ble Minister (Finance). Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana is not being implemented separately, but the current special component scheme, Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana, is being implemented from 2016-17 as per the changed criteria, taking into account the needs of the changed situation and maintaining soil moisture.
Also, the government has approved the amendment in the financial criteria and inclusion of new components under the said scheme as per the government decision dated 01 October, 2024.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    beneficiary Selection criteria are as follows
1.  Scheme is only for Scheduled Caste/ Nav Baudha farmers.
2.  Scheme is implemented in all districts of Maharashtra (Except Mumbai districts).
3. At field level  scheme is under Implementation by department of Agriculture, Zilha Parishad.
4. Funds are released from Social Justice Department to concerned  District Collector and then made available to concern Zilha Parishad.
5. Application ,Selection of beneficiaries upto payment of subsidy all process are done through MAHADBT Portal through online system.                                                                  "

*Benefits*:
Benefit provided on subsidy basis as per the norms of components, through online system. The said scheme shall be implemented in the financial year 2025-26 as follows. In the said scheme, grants shall be admissible for the following components in the year 2025-26 up to the maximum limit of the amount mentioned below.
1. For New Irrigation- Well Maximum subsidy ammount limit is Rs.4,00,000/ - is admissible.
2. For Old Well Repair - Maximum subsidy ammount limit is 1,00,000/- is admissible
3. Plastic Lining of Farm Ponds-Grant shall be admissible up to 90% of the amount calculated as per the prevailing financial parameters of the National Horticulture Mission Guideline and the size of the farm pond or actual cost or Rs. 2,00,000/- whichever is less is admissible.
4.Inwell Boring- Maximum subsidy ammount limit is 40,000/- is admissible
5. Electricity Connection-Maximum subsidy ammount limit is Amount 20,000/- or actual paid amount whichever is less is admissible.
6. Pump Set (Diesel/Electric)(Diesel Engine - New Item) For pump sets up to 10 HP capacity, grant shall be admissible up to 90% of the prevailing financial parameters or actual cost or Rs. 40,000/- whichever is less is admissible.
7. Grant Solar pump (instead of electrical connection and pump set)- Maximum subsidy will be admissible up to 90% of the prevailing financial criteria or actual expenditure incurred or Rs. 50,000/- whichever is less is admissible.
8. HDPE/PVC Pipe (New Item)- Under the Food and Nutrition Security Scheme - Food Crops Scheme, subsidy of 100% of the prevailing economic standard or actual cost incurred per meter or Rs. 50,000/- whichever is less will be admissible.
9.1 For Micro irrigation system Under Sprinkler Irrigation Set (Supplementary Grant) 9.1.1) Under the Per Drop More Crop Scheme, (1) 55% for small/very small landholders + 25% from the Chief Minister's Sustainable Irrigation Scheme + 10% from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana and9.1.2) 45% for large landholders + 30% from the Chief Minister's Sustainable Irrigation Scheme + 15% from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana or Rs. 47,000/- whichever is less will be admissible as subsidy. (Total subsidy limit of 90 percent) is admissible
9.2 For Drip Irrigation Set Supplementary Grant 9.2.1 ) Under the Per Drop More Crop Scheme, (1) 55% for small/very small landholders + 25% from the Chief Minister's Sustainable Irrigation Scheme + 10% from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana and 9.2.2) 45% for large landholders + 30% from the Chief Minister's Sustainable Irrigation Scheme + 15% from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana or Rs. 97,000/- whichever is less will be admissible as subsidy.(Total subsidy limit of 90 percent) is admissible
10. Farm Machinery (bullock-drawn/tractor-drawn implements) (New item)maximum subsidy limit is 50,000/- is admissible
11. Backyard / Kitchen Garden (New Item) maximum subsidy limit is 50,000/- is admissible .

*Eligibility*:
1. Scheme is only for Scheduled Tribe farmers. Caste  certificate is essential.
2. Land holding limit is 0.20 ha. to  6.00 ha.(for benefit of New well component minimum 0.40 ha. land essential)
3.1 It will be mandatory for the beneficiary to be a farmer belonging to the Scheduled Caste / Neo-Buddhist category.
3.2 The farmer must have a caste certificate issued by the competent authority.
3.3 Farmers residing the Outside the Nagar Panchayat, Nagarpalika and Mahanagarpalika is necessary to have 7/12 certificate and 8A extract of land tenure in the name of the farmer. ( Outside the Nagar Panchayat, Nagarpalika and Mahanagarpalika area (Reference Government Letter No. Sankirna- 2017/Pr.No.142/3A, dated 24 April 2018))
3.4 The beneficiaries must have their own Aadhaar link active bank account .
3.5 The beneficiaries below the poverty line will be given  first priority.
3.6 The beneficiary farmer must have a minimum of 0.40 hectares and a maximum of 6 hectares of agricultural land. If the beneficiary's land is in a remote and fragmented area and two or more beneficiaries with less than 0.40 hectares of land come together and their combined land is at least 0.40 hectares, then if they sign an agreement, they will be eligible for the benefit of the scheme. Similarly, the condition of maximum 6.0 hectares of land will not be applicable to the beneficiaries below the poverty line.
3.7 Once the full benefit of the relevant scheme is taken, the benefit of this scheme will not be payable to the same beneficiary or family for the next five years. The beneficiary who has taken the benefit of the new well component will be eligible for the benefit of the old well repair component after 20 years.
If the benefit has been given under the Special Component Scheme for similar agricultural development schemes and the scheme implemented from the funds made available under the SCA of the Central Government and Article 275 (A) of the Constitution, the benefit provided under this scheme will not be admissible.

*Required Documents*:
1. Caste Certificate of SC category issued by compitant authority
2. current 7/12 report having Land holding limit is 0.20 ha. to 6.00 ha.(for benefit of New well component minimum 0.40 ha. land essential) within the period of
3 months 3.GSDA Certificates
4. There is no income limit for this scheme

*Application Process*:
Application is to done online on Mahadbt portal as follows
1. Applications from farmers are being invited for the said scheme on the Maha-DBT portal website mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in/farmer/login /login and the applications received within the limit of lakhs received by the concerned talukas / blocks will be selected online on a first come, first served basis (fcfs). After selection, all the proceedings up to the payment of subsidy to the beneficiaries should be done online. In this regard, proceedings from acceptance of application to payment of subsidy to the beneficiaries should be done as mentioned in the referenced government decision dated 04/11/2020.
2. The Agricultural Officer (Agriculture), P.S., should conduct a site inspection of the area of the beneficiary selected for the new well and old well repair on a first come, first served basis and check the technical feasibility. After the inspection, if the location of the beneficiary's new well and the proposal for repair of the old well of the beneficiary is technically suitable, the Agricultural Development Officer should approve the budget for this matter and give prior approval to the proposals of the concerned beneficiary within a maximum of 30 days after uploading the documents. Similarly, the selection of the beneficiaries whose proposals are found to be technically unsuitable during the site inspection should be cancelled.
3. Beneficiaries selected for other matters other than new well and old well repair under the scheme should be given prior approval within a maximum of 30 days after uploading the documents and they should be given the benefit of the scheme in the current financial year 2025-26 itself.
4. The prior approval of the beneficiaries who do not implement the matters under the scheme within the prescribed period should be cancelled.
5. While selecting individual beneficiary, priority will be given to women and disabled beneficiaries. Out of the total sanctioned funds, 5 percent of the funds should be given priority to be spent on disabled beneficiaries and 30 percent of the funds should be spent on women beneficiaries.
6. As per the demand of the final selected beneficiaries as per the target of the taluka & district, a draft plan of the district should be prepared within 7 days as per Appendix No. 1, component-wise and beneficiary-wise. The responsibility of preparing the draft plan will be the responsibility of the Agricultural Development Officer.

agristack_workflow.evidence: Agent fetched Agristack (ST, 0.68 ha, PoCRA: No; Nandurbar) but did not leverage it to personalize eligibility or tailor guidance (e.g., ST-linked benefits, PoCRA constraint messaging). For general info this is acceptable, but the user’s loss-related query warranted personalization.

term_identification.evidence: User asked for support for fruit and flower crop damage. PMFBY is relevant, but the agent also listed an accident compensation scheme (गोपीनाथ मुंडे) and BAKSY (irrigation assets) which do not address crop damage. It also missed RWBCIS (weather-based crop insurance), directly relevant to damage from weather.

tool_sequencing.evidence: Used get_scheme_codes followed by multiple get_scheme_info calls. Correct order; could be more efficient via get_multiple_schemes_info for multiple schemes.

search_quality.evidence: N/A - reason: No document search was required for the scheme workflow.

output_hygiene.evidence: No tool names or JSON leaked in the user-facing reply; clean Marathi formatting. Minor duplication of the citation line only.

source_alignment.evidence: Scheme details match tool outputs: PMFBY portal/docs, Gopinath Munde (age 10–75, up to ₹2 lakh), BAKSY component limits (e.g., ₹4 lakh for new well), and NSMNY (₹6,000/year) align correctly.

no_fabrication.evidence: No invented data or guarantees; guidance and amounts reflect tool data. No false timelines or subsidy guarantees.

citation_accuracy.evidence: Used the standard citation 'स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती' appropriate for scheme information responses.

safety_compliance.evidence: Only scheme information provided; no chemical or unsafe advice.

completeness.evidence: Missed RWBCIS, a key complementary crop insurance scheme; didn’t cover claim intimation/assessment steps for crop loss or clarify notified crop/area conditions. Included two less relevant schemes for the stated need.

actionability.evidence: Provided PMFBY portal and documents; GM scheme submission window (30 days) noted; basic application info for BAKSY/NSMNY. Lacked step-by-step PMFBY claim guidance and local contact specifics for loss reporting.

context_fit.evidence: Agristack shows ST farmer, 0.68 ha, non-PoCRA village in Nandurbar. The reply did not personalize messaging (e.g., acknowledging non-PoCRA, ST-linked benefits where applicable) and focused insufficiently on loss-relief pathways.

clarity.evidence: Well-structured sections in Marathi; easy to read, though inclusion of unrelated schemes may confuse prioritization.

conversation_closure.evidence: Ends with a generic follow-up question. Did not proactively offer to check whether the crop is notified under PMFBY for the district/season or to guide claim initiation timelines.

grammar.evidence: Generally correct Marathi. Notable error: 'नव्या वावटळीसाठी' should be 'नव्या विहिरीसाठी' under BAKSY, which changes meaning.

terminology.evidence: Mostly correct terms like 'पात्रता', 'अनुदान', 'अर्ज', but misuse of 'वावटळ' for 'विहीर' reduces precision; some transliteration like 'e-pik pahani' could be standardized as 'ई-पिक पाहणी'.

language_purity.evidence: Minimal English; scheme names/acronyms acceptable. Marathi remains predominant.

fluency.evidence: Natural, organized bullet points; reads smoothly aside from the terminology slip.

evaluation.summary: Accurate and cleanly presented scheme info with correct citations, but the response missed a key relevant scheme (RWBCIS), included less relevant schemes for crop damage, and failed to use Agristack data for personalization or to guide PMFBY claim steps. Language quality is good overall with a notable terminology error.

question: मी MIDH पात्र आहे का
answer:
**मिशन फॉर इंटिग्रेटेड डेव्हलपमेंट ऑफ हॉर्टिकल्चर (MIDH) - पाण्याची स्रोत स्थापना**  
आपल्याला पाण्याची स्रोत स्थापना (फार्म पॉन्ड लाईनिंग) या घटकासाठी अनुदान मिळवता येईल, जर आपण फळबाग, भाजीपाला किंवा इतर फळबाग उत्पादन करत असाल.

**मुख्य लाभ:**  
- फार्म पॉन्ड लाईनिंगसाठी ५०% प्रत्यक्ष खर्च किंवा अधिकतम शिल्लकपैकी कमी किंमत अनुदान मिळते.  
- ७ वेगवेगळ्या आकाराच्या फार्म पॉन्ड लाईनिंगसाठी शिल्लक आहे (उदा. १५×१५×३ मीटर, २०×१५×३ मीटर, इ.).  
- लाईनिंगसाठी ५०० मायक्रॉन बिस अनुमोदित HDPE फिल्म वापरावी लागते.  
- फायदा मिळवण्यासाठी आपल्याकडे फळबाग किंवा भाजीपाला उत्पादन असावे.

**पात्रता:**  
- फळबाग किंवा भाजीपाला उत्पादन करणारे शेतकरी पात्र आहेत.

**आवश्यक कागदपत्रे:**  
1. आग्रीस्टॅक शेतकरी आयडी  
2. ७/१२ व ८ए (शेतकरी आयडीवरून उपलब्ध होतील)  
3. बँक पासबुकची पहिली पाने  
4. अनुसूचित जाती/जमाती शेतकऱ्यांसाठी जात प्रमाणपत्र  
5. संयुक्त शेतजमीन असल्यास संमतीपत्र  
6. गुरुत्वाच्या प्रमाणपत्रातील अटींनुसार गुंतवणूक निश्चित करण्यासाठी गुरुत्वाचे पत्र  
7. खर्चाची बिल/इन्वॉइस

**अर्ज प्रक्रिया:**  
- अर्ज महाडीबीटी पोर्टलवर ऑनलाईन करावा लागतो: https://mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in

आपण फळबाग किंवा भाजीपाला उत्पादन करत असल्यास आपण या योजनेसाठी पात्र आहात.

**स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती**

आपल्याला अर्ज करण्यासाठी अधिक माहिती हवी आहे का? किंवा इतर कोणत्या शासकीय योजनांची माहिती हवी आहे का?

*Scheme Name*:
Mission for Integrated Development of Horticulture (MIDH)

*Main Component*:
Creation of Water resources

*Sub Component*:
Individual Plastic Lining to farm pond

*Introduction*:
Under the Mission, assistance will be provided for creating water sources through Plastic Lining to farm pond, to ensure thectaret the stored water does not get wasted due to seepage and to use the stored water to sustain the orchectarerds during times of water scarcity.

*Benefits*:
Benefit is given to farmers cultivating the horticulture crops. Benefit includes the cost of plastic lining to farm pond Subsidy will be given @ 50% of actual cost or maximum ceiling limit whichever is low. Under this scheme seven models are allowed for plastic lining to farm pond. These are 15m*15*3 m (441cubic meter), 20*15*3 m (621 cubic meter), 20*20*3 m (876 cubic meter), 25*20*3 m (1131 cubic meter), 25*25*3 m (1461cubic meter), 30*25*3 m (1791 cubic meter), & 30*30*3 m (2196 cubic meter) The cost norm and subsidy for different models for Individual Plastic Lining to farm pond are as fallows. maximum cost norm for 15m*15*3 m (441cubic meter) model is 0.57 lakh and subsidy is 0.28 lakh. for 20*15*3 m (621 cubic meter) model maximum cost norm is 0.63 lakh and subsidy is 0.32 lakh, for 20*20*3 m (876 cubic meter) model maximum cost norm is 0.82 lakh and subsidy is 0.41 lakh, for 25*20*3 m (1131 cubic meter) model maximum cost norm is 0.99 lakh and subsidy is 0.50 lakh, for 25*25*3 m (1461cubic meter) model maximum cost norm is 1.17 lakh and subsidy is 0.59 lakh, for 30*25*3 m (1791 cubic meter)model maximum cost norm is 1.35 lakh and subsidy is 0.68 lakh & for 30*30*3 m (2196 cubic meter) model maximum cost norm is 1.56 lakh and subsidy is 0.75 lakh
Paper used for lining to farm pond should possess the prescribed BIS standards thectaret is 500 micron thickness Reinforced HDPE geomembrane film. This paper should be purchectaresed only from registered supplyers.

*Eligibility*:
Farmers should hectareve horticulture crop under cultivation

*Required Documents*:
1. Agristack Farmer ID
2. 7/12 and 8A (can be fetched through farmer ID)
3. Photocopy of the first page of the bank passbook (Aadhectarear linked Nationalised bank account details)
4. Caste certificate for Scheduled Caste and Scheduled tribes farmers
5. Consent letter if joint land holder
6. Guarantee letter in prescribed format
7. Bill/Invoice

*Application Process*:
Application is to done online on Mahectaredbt portal
https://mahectaredbt.maharashtra.gov.in

question: माझ्या भागातील अधिकारी काय सेवा देतात?

question: डाळिंब किंवा मका लागवडीसाठी शासकीय योजना उपलब्ध आहेत का?
answer:
आपल्या डाळिंब किंवा मका लागवडीसाठी शासकीय योजनांची माहिती खालीलप्रमाणे आहे:

**१. कृषी उत्पादन लागवडीसाठी शासकीय योजना (मिडीएच)**
- या योजनेअंतर्गत उत्तम गुणवत्तेचे बियाणे आणि लागवडीसाठी लागणारे पौष्टिक रोपे तयार करण्यासाठी अनुदान मिळते.
- लाभ: 
  - मोठ्या नर्सरीसाठी (१ ते २ हेक्टर) प्रति हेक्टर जनसंघटनेसाठी ₹३० लाख, खाजगी संस्थांना ₹१२ लाख अनुदान.
  - लहान नर्सरीसाठी (०.४० ते १ हेक्टर) प्रति हेक्टर जनसंघटनेसाठी ₹२० लाख, खाजगी संस्थांना ₹१० लाख अनुदान.
- पात्रता: तीन वर्षांचा अनुभव असलेल्या किंवा नव्याने सुरू केलेल्या नर्सरीसाठी योग्य.
- अर्ज प्रक्रिया: महाडीबीटी पोर्टलवर ऑनलाइन अर्ज करावा (https://mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in)
- आवश्यक कागदपत्रे: ७/१२ उतारा, बँक पासबुक, जात प्रमाणपत्र, अनुदानासाठी गारंटी पत्र, योजना विवरण, बिल/इन्व्हॉइस इ.

**२. प्रधानमंत्री किसान सन्मान निधी (PM-KISAN)**
- प्रत्येक शेतकरी कुटुंबाला वर्षाला ₹६,००० अनुदान (तीन हप्त्यांमध्ये) मिळते.
- पात्रता: शेती जमीन असलेले आर्थिकदृष्ट्या कमकुवत शेतकरी कुटुंब.
- अर्ज प्रक्रिया: पीएमकिसान पोर्टलवर ऑनलाइन अर्ज (https://pmkisan.gov.in)
- आवश्यक कागदपत्रे: ७/१२ उतारा, आधार कार्ड, बँक खाते.

**३. प्रधानमंत्री पीक विमा योजना (PMFBY)**
- निवडलेल्या पिकांसाठी विमा संरक्षण मिळते. जमिनीवर नुकसान झाल्यास विमा रक्कम मिळते.
- पात्रता: निवडलेल्या पिकांसाठी व निवडलेल्या भागातील सर्व शेतकरी.
- अर्ज प्रक्रिया: पीएमएफबीवाय पोर्टलवर ऑनलाइन अर्ज (https://pmfby.gov.in)
- आवश्यक कागदपत्रे: ७/१२ उतारा, आधार कार्ड, बँक खाते, जमीन व पिकाची माहिती.

**४. कृषी अवकाश आधारभूत सुविधा निधी (AIF)**
- शेताजवळील प्राथमिक व द्वितीयक पश्चात्ताप व्यवस्था (गोदाम, फ्रॉस्ट, पॅकिंग हाऊस इ.) साठी ३% व्याज सवलत व बँक ऋणासाठी गारंटी.
- पात्रता: शेताजवळील अवकाश आधारभूत सुविधांसाठी ऋण अर्ज.
- अर्ज प्रक्रिया: बँकेच्या शास्त्रीय योजनेसह अर्ज.

**५. प्रधानमंत्री किसान मानधन योजना (PM-KMY)**
- लहान व अल्पभूधारक शेतकऱ्यांना १८ ते ४० वयोगटातील शेतकरी योजनेत नोंदणी करून मासिक ₹५५ ते ₹२०० जमा करून ६० वर्षांनंतर ₹३,००० पेन्शन मिळते.
- अर्ज प्रक्रिया: पीएमकेएमवाय पोर्टलवर ऑनलाइन अर्ज (https://pmkmy.gov.in)

Risk covered -  Crop cutting base average yield reduction in comparison to threshhold yield for that insurance unit( Revenue circle)

4. Threshold yield  is determined by taking into account the average average yield  of the  best five years from past 7 years multiplied by  indemnity level
5. The scheme is implemented on beed pattern (80:110) where Insurance companies claim liability is up to 110 %  of the gross premium  or 110% of the burn cost whichever is higher for the given cluster in given season . *Eligibility*:
1. All the farmers  growing notified crops in the notified area are eligible.
2. The scheme is  optional for Loanee & Non-loanee farmers.

Sum insured per hector: Sum insured per hectare is decided as per scale of finance for that crop

language_purity.evidence: Some unnecessary English usage (वेअरहाऊस, मॅनेजर); otherwise mostly Marathi.

fluency.evidence: Readable and natural enough, but slight mismatch in concept (processing vs storage) affects perceived fluency/appropriateness.

evaluation.summary: The agent correctly geocoded Sangli and listed nearby facilities grounded in tool data with a proper citation, but it answered with warehouses (storage) instead of turmeric processing centers, missing the user's intent. Wrong category selection (warehouse vs CHC/processing) is a critical process error, and the guidance for actual processing was minimal.
